 Appearance:
 MR HANNAN A QURESHI(11351) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3  MR VIRALKUMAR R SOLANKI(11489) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3  MS URMILA N DESAI(5609) for the Respondent(s) No. 2  MS SHRUTI PATHAK, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DIVYESH A. JOSHI  Date : 06/03/2025
ORAL ORDER 1. Rule returnable forthwith.
Ms. Shruti Pathak, the learned APP waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent - State of Gujarat.
Ms. Urmila Desai, learned advocate waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the for the respondent no.2 - original complainant.

2. By this application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the applicants-original accused seek to invoke the inherent powers of this Court praying for quashing of the proceedings of the FIR being C.R. No.11199021211857 of 2021 registered with Ankleshwar GIDC Police Station, Bharuch for the offence punishable under Sections-406, 114, 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: 3. Heard learned advocates appearing for the respective parties.

4. Mr. Hannan Qureshi, learned advocate appearing for the applicants submits that the applicants are residing at Canada and the marriage of the applicant no.1 and complainant was solemnized before the Registrar of Marriage.
Due to some disputes, the respondent no.2 has filed FIR against the applicants.
He further submits that pursuant to the registration of the FIR, investigation was carried out and ultimately, at the end of day, charge-sheet was submitted before the competent court.
As soon as the said fact came to the knowledge of the applicants, they have approached this Hon'ble Court by way of preferring present application.
He further submits that during the pendency of present proceedings, the matter has already been settled between the parties and the complainant is not willing to carry out the proceedings further.

He further submits that the complainant and applicant no.1 had file an application under Section-13(B) of the Hindu Marriage Act for the purpose of getting divorce by mutual consent, which was decided and the learned Family Court, Ankleshwar has allowed the application and decree of divorce is granted.
He further submits that on basis of settlement arrived at between the parties, the complainant does not want to proceed further now.
The complainant has filed affidavit specifically stating the said fact that if the proceedings of present complaint is quashed, in that event, she has no objection.
An affidavit to that effect has also been filed by the complainant.
It is, therefore, urged that the present applications may be allowed.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/23521/2022 ORDER DATED: 06/03/2025 undefined 5.

Learned advocate Ms. Urmila Desai, for the respondent no.2 - original complainant has submitted that the respondent no.2 - complainant has personally remained present before this court and she has no objection, if the proceedings qua the present applicants would be quashed.
Learned advocate further submits that the applicant no.1 and respondent no.2 has granted divorce decree by the learned Family Court and the respondent no.2 has already been remarried.
On the basis of settlement pursis, the respondent no.2 does not want to pursue further.
Learned advocate further submits that the disputes is settled between the parties and an affidavit in that regard is already filed by the complainant.

Learned advocate has identified the signature of the complainant as well as identified the respondent no.2 - original complainant, who is personally present before this Court and also confirmed correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by her.
6. Learned APP has submitted that appropriate order may be passed on the strength of the settlement arrived at between the parties.

7. Therefore, since now, the dispute with reference to the impugned FIR is settled and resolved by and between parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through his learned advocate,
the trial would be futile and any further continuation of proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law.
Therefore, the impugned FIR is required to be quashed and set aside.

The affidavit filed by the respondent no.2- NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/23521/2022 ORDER DATED:
06/03/2025 undefined original complainant is ordered to be taken on record.
Even the divorce decree passed by the learned Family Court is also ordered to be taken on record.
